mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content_checksum AS checksum, COUNT(c.id) AS chunk_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.embedding_json IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS embedded_chunk_count, MAX(c.embedding_model) AS embedding_model FROM knowledge_document d LEFT JOIN knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.content_checksum = #{checksum} GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.content_checksum
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (id, submission_id, title, source_type, source_business_id, source_url, source_name, source_author, author_user_id, file_name, document_type, pet_type, category, language_code, content, content_checksum, status, review_status, trust_level, quality_score, consent_status, reviewer_user_id, reviewed_at, version, published_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{submissionId}, #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceBusinessId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceAuthor}, #{authorUserId}, #{fileName}, #{documentType}, #{petType}, #{category}, 'zh-CN', #{content}, #{contentChecksum}, 'READY', 'APPROVED', #{trustLevel}, #{qualityScore}, #{consentStatus}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{reviewedAt}, #{version}, #{publishedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{publishedAt}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', consent_status = 'WITHDRAWN', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (id, document_id, chunk_index, content, char_count, token_estimate, embedding_json, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, page_start, page_end, embedded_at, created_at) VALUES
(#{chunk.id}, #{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.charCount}, #{chunk.tokenEstimate}, #{chunk.embeddingJson}, #{chunk.embeddingModel}, #{chunk.embeddingDimensions}, #{chunk.pageStart}, #{chunk.pageEnd}, #{chunk.embeddedAt}, #{chunk.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.title, d.source_name, d.file_name, d.document_type, d.pet_type, d.category, d.status, COUNT(c.id) AS chunk_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.embedding_json IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS embedded_chunk_count, MAX(c.embedding_model) AS embedding_model, d.created_at FROM knowledge_document d LEFT JOIN knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.source_name, d.file_name, d.document_type, d.pet_type, d.category, d.status, d.created_at ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, title, source_url AS sourceUrl, source_name AS sourceName, file_name AS fileName, document_type AS documentType, pet_type AS petType, category, content FROM knowledge_document WHERE status = 'READY' AND review_status = 'APPROVED' AND consent_status != 'WITHDRAWN' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY created_at, id
